class.name: InputMapSettingsRow
class.brief_description: One action as stored in a version 2 file of [InputMapSettingsServer].
class.description: The file form of an [InputAction] in the settings files of [InputMapSettingsServer] before format version 3: the events are one text cell ([member bindings]). The server only reads it, to load old files; it writes [InputMapSettingsAction] and [InputMapSettingsEventRow]. Games do not need this class.

members.member: The events of the action as text, as written by [method InputMapSettingsServer.events_to_text], for example [code]Key:Ctrl+J; JoypadButton:A[/code]. The names of version 2 are read by [method InputMapSettingsServer.text_to_events].
